title: Editorial check storage, plugin and Lambda
description:
Storage, plugin and execution path for Limatus checks.

## Scope
- `limatus` plugin manifest in `amplify/plugins/registry.ts` (`resolveConfig`, `publicSettings`).
- AppSync models in `amplify/data/schema.ts`: `EditorialPolicy` (lineage/version, scope publication|section, payload JSON validated against Limatus `policy-pack-v1`), `EditorialCheckSettings` singleton, `EditorialCheckRun` (item id + content hash, status, result JSON or attachment), `EditorialFeedback` labels.
- Python Lambda `editorial-check` (bundle limatus; `TYPESAFE_API_KEY`, `OPENAI_API_KEY` via `secret()`): `startEditorialCheck`, `getEditorialCheck`, `suggestRewrites`.
- Async run lifecycle and subscription; incremental rescans reuse cached segment results.
- Pre-publish **warning** (never a gate): `publishItem` UI shows outstanding `error`/`warn` findings and lets the editor publish anyway.
- Replace the `papyrus editorial diagnose|options` CLI wrapper and re-export shims with the new `check`/`suggest` contract.

## Blocked by
LIM-6a84be (contracts). Can stub with schema fixtures before LIM lanes land.
